questions.answer: A quantity that has magnitude only.
A quantity that has both magnitude and direction.

questions.prompt: State one scalar and one vector quantity.
questions.answer: Scalar: any of distance, speed, mass, energy, time, temperature. Vector: any of displacement, velocity, force, acceleration, momentum.
If the resultant force on an object is zero, a stationary object stays at rest and a moving object continues at the same speed in the same direction (constant velocity).

questions.prompt: State the resultant force on an object moving at constant velocity.
State the equation linking resultant force, mass and acceleration.
questions.answer: Resultant force = mass x acceleration (F = ma).
